data.summary_en: MemPilot improves on-demand memory organization under performance–cost–latency preferences via reinforcement learning optimizing multi-step LLM policy: retrieve query-agnostic memory or delegate heterogeneous LLM/VLM for query-wise multimodal history organization, controlling evidence amount, instruction, model, visual access; five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks: preference-sweep frontier wider than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
